D: A bunch of misfits sign up for the police academy.
P: Serve the mains when the cadets end up at the Blue Oyster bar.
S: Buttermilk cornbread baked in a hot buttered cast iron pan
Whisk cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, buttermilk, eggs and melted butter, pour into a hot buttered cast iron pan, bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
Fresh oysters on crushed ice with red wine vinegar and shallot
Oysters on ice with a shallot mignonette and lemon, or grilled with garlic butter for the nervous.
M: Beef and pork meatloaf with a tomato glaze
Beef and pork mince with breadcrumbs, egg, onion and Worcestershire, shaped in a tin, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash.
W: Vanilla slab cake covered in buttercream, with a blue badge piped on top
Vanilla slab cake with buttercream, piped with a police badge and "Graduates" in blue icing.
K: Vodka, blue curaçao and lemon juice shaken and served over ice

Vodka and blue curaçao shaken with fresh lemon, topped with cold lemonade over ice and finished with a lemon wheel and a cherry. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Shake 160ml vodka, 80ml blue curaçao and 60ml fresh lemon juice with ice for 10 seconds. Strain evenly into the glasses. Top each with about 120ml cold lemonade and stir once. Garnish with a lemon wheel and a cocktail cherry.

steps.text: Heat a buttered cast iron pan in a 200C oven.
Whisk the dry ingredients with the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter.
Pour into the hot pan and bake.
Serve warm with butter.
Finely dice the shallot and mix with the vinegar and pepper for the mignonette.
Shuck the oysters and lay on crushed ice.
Spoon a little mignonette over each and serve with lemon wedges.
Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg, grated onion and Worcestershire.
Press into a loaf tin and glaze with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar.
Bake at 180C.
Boil the potatoes while the meatloaf bakes.
Rest the meatloaf, mash the potatoes with butter and milk and serve thick slices.
Heat the oven to 175C and line a slab tin. Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour and milk.
Bake.
Cool the cake completely.
Beat the butter with the icing sugar and tint blue.
Spread on the cake.
Pipe a badge and the word Graduates in blue.
Fill tall glasses with ice.
Shake the vodka, curacao and lemon juice with ice and strain into the glasses.
Top with lemonade, stir once and garnish with a lemon wheel and a cherry.

s.note: Buttermilk cornbread baked in a hot buttered cast iron pan
s.how: Heat a buttered cast iron pan in a 200C oven. Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 60g melted butter. Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes. Serve warm with butter.

s.note: Fresh oysters on crushed ice with red wine vinegar and shallot
s.how: Finely dice 1 shallot and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar and cracked pepper. Lay 16 freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice, spoon a little mignonette over each and serve with lemon wedges. Grill a few with garlic butter for anyone nervous about raw.

m.note: Beef and pork meatloaf with a tomato glaze
m.how: Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 60g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, 1 grated onion and 1 tbsp Worcestershire. Press into a loaf tin, glaze with 80ml tomato sauce mixed with 1 tbsp brown sugar, bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Serve thick slices with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and milk.

w.note: Vanilla slab cake covered in buttercream, with a blue badge piped on top
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake in a slab tin at 175C for 30 minutes. Beat 200g butter with 350g icing sugar, spread on and pipe a badge and Graduates in blue.

d.note: Vodka, blue curaçao and lemon juice shaken and served over ice
d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Shake 160ml vodka, 80ml blue curaçao and 60ml fresh lemon juice with ice for 10 seconds. Strain evenly into the glasses. Top each with about 120ml cold lemonade and stir once. Garnish with a lemon wheel and a cocktail cherry.
